_comment: Content that MUST stay Chinese in English / French. Each entry: text (regex on the string), sel (regex on the element path), route (regex on the route), reason. An entry needs at least one of text / sel / route.

allow.reason: The language menu names every language in its own script (中文 / English / Français), so that a user who cannot read the current language finds theirs.
Quotes the exact label that the user's Chinese Google / Excel sheet must contain in column A (the import reads this Chinese pattern); an example in another language would not be recognised.
